words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请出示您的护照和登机牌。(Qǐng chūshì nín de hùzhào hé dēngjīpái.) — Please show your passport and boarding pass.
去国外旅游需要提前办理签证。(Qù guówài lǚyóu xūyào tíqián bànlǐ qiānzhèng.) — Traveling abroad requires applying for a visa in advance.
先生，请问您有几件托运行李？(Xiānsheng, qǐngwèn nín yǒu jǐ jiàn tuōyùn xíngli?) — Sir, how many pieces of checked luggage do you have?
我的行李箱子装得满满的。(Wǒ de xíngli xiāngzi zhuāng de mǎnmǎn de.) — My suitcase is packed full.
我已经网上预订了三晚的酒店。(Wǒ yǐjīng wǎngshang yùdìng le sān wǎn de jiǔdiàn.) — I've already booked three nights at the hotel online.
这家五星级酒店环境很优雅。(Zhè jiā wǔxīngjí jiǔdiàn huánjìng hěn yōuyǎ.) — The environment of this five-star hotel is very elegant.
你好，我来办理入住手续。(Nǐ hǎo, wǒ lái bànlǐ rùzhù shǒuxù.) — Hello, I am here to process my check-in.
酒店规定中午十二点前退房。(Jiǔdiàn guīdìng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián tuìfáng.) — The hotel policy requires checking out before 12:00 noon.
我想订一间安静的单人房。(Wǒ xiǎng dìng yì jiān ānjìng de dānrénfáng.) — I'd like to reserve a quiet single room.
我们两个人要一间双人房。(Wǒmen liǎng gè rén yào yì jiān shuāngrénfáng.) — The two of us want a double room.
故宫博物院的门票需要提前预约。(Gùgōng Bówùyuàn de ménpiào xūyào tíqián yùyuē.) — Palace Museum tickets require advance reservation.
长城是北京最著名的旅游景点。(Chángchéng shì Běijīng zuì zhùmíng de lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn.) — The Great Wall is Beijing's most famous attraction.
导游正在给游客讲解古建筑历史。(Dǎoyóu zhèngzài gěi yóukè jiǎngjiě gǔ jiànzhù lìshǐ.) — The tour guide is explaining the ancient architecture history.
我买了很有中国特色的小纪念品。(Wǒ mǎi le hěn yǒu Zhōngguó tèsè de xiǎo jìniànpǐn.) — I bought some souvenirs with Chinese characteristics.
飞往上海的航班将于半小时后起飞。(Fēiwǎng Shànghǎi de hángbān jiāng yú bàn xiǎoshí hòu qǐfēi.) — The flight to Shanghai will depart in half an hour.
请在自助机器上打印您的登机牌。(Qǐng zài zìzhù jīqì shang dǎyìn nín de dēngjīpái.) — Please print your boarding pass at the self-service kiosk.
过安检时请把电脑和液体拿出来。(Guò ānjiǎn shí qǐng bǎ diànnǎo hé yètǐ ná chūlái.) — When passing security, please take out laptops and liquids.
由于天气原因，列车延误了半小时。(Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, lièchē yánwù le bàn xiǎoshí.) — Due to weather conditions, the train is delayed 30 minutes.
飞机非常准时地降落在北京机场。(Fēijī fēicháng zhǔnshí de jiàngluò zài Běijīng jīchǎng.) — The airplane landed punctually at Beijing airport.
山顶上的自然风景美丽极了。(Shāndǐng shang de zìrán fēngjǐng měilì jí le.) — The natural scenery at the mountain top is magnificent.
您可以去游客咨询中心询问路线。(Nǐ kěyǐ qù yóukè zīxún zhōngxīn xúnwèn lùxiàn.) — You can inquire about routes at the tourist information center.
导游建议我们早上八点出发。(Dǎoyóu jiànyì wǒmen zǎoshang bā diǎn chūfā.) — The tour guide suggested we depart at 8:00 AM.
祝您在中国度过一段愉快的时光！(Zhù nín zài Zhōngguó dùguò yí duàn yúkuài de shíguāng!) — Wish you a wonderful time in China!
收拾好行李，我们准备出发了。(Shōushi hǎo xíngli, wǒmen zhǔnbèi chūfā le.) — Packed up our luggage, we're ready to set off.
预计高铁将在中午十二点到达上海。(Yùjì gāotiě jiāng zài zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn dàodá Shànghǎi.) — The high-speed rail is estimated to arrive in Shanghai at 12:00 noon.
